📰 Your Deleted Files Aren't Gone: NIST on Data Wiping

Deleting a file often just removes its reference, leaving the actual data blocks recoverable. NIST guidelines emphasize distinct sanitization methods for HDDs and SSDs to prevent sensitive data exposure. Developers must adopt proper wiping techniques for keys and confidential information.

📅 13 Oct 2026 | Source: NIST Guidelines for Media Sanitization
